changes: DMG pixel and sprite palette conversion now uses direct packed-table indexing in both whole-line and live scanline rendering, reducing per-pixel dispatch while preserving the exact colour mapping.
In real games this gives the CPU more headroom for scrolling playfields, text-heavy HUDs, sprite compositing, LCD shaders, audio and input work; the emulated cadence remains fixed at 59.7275 Hz.

Fresh-process paired benchmarks matched framebuffer/CPU checksums and measured +1.76% Super Mario Land, +7.46% Link's Awakening, +2.27% Pokémon Blue, +2.42% Wario Land 3, −0.30% Shantae (run variance), and +1.97% Pokémon Crystal.
No PPU, CPU, APU, mapper, RTC, save-state, or BIOS behavior was intentionally changed; Mealybug remains 88.7153% structural match with the v2.2.0 core.

The offline single-file build, v2.2 window-fetch work, and prior audio, DMA, mapper, RTC, save, and input improvements remain intact; remaining accuracy gaps stay documented rather than hidden behind a performance claim.
